CommandLineResponse.description: One authoritative command-line projection and its optimistic-concurrency revision.

CommandTarget.description: The desk-local default scope used when an operator starts a command.

CueMoveCopyChoice.description: Choice presented when Cue copy or move semantics would otherwise be ambiguous.

DynamicSpatialProjectionProjection.description:
One position and one direction place every projection kind.

`view_direction` is the viewing direction for planar, the central axis for cylindrical, and
the direction to the centre of the spread for spherical. `rotation_degrees` is the roll about
it: the turn of the viewing plane for planar and the start angle around the axis for
cylindrical. `anchor` is the plane origin for planar and the centre point for the other two.

GroupMappingProjectionKind.description:
How a Stage position becomes the pair the shape ranks on. Absent means `planar`, which is
what every projection stored before the other two kinds existed is.

PatchDelta.description: Targeted post-mutation projection suitable for a Patch store and a typed patch-change event.

event_sequence.description: Sequence of the semantic patch-change event, absent for a no-op desired-state request.

profile_revisions.description: Unique metadata needed to interpret the fixture projections in this delta.

ip_address.description: Transport adapters validate this as an IP address before invoking the application service.

PatchFixtureProjection.description: Portable, authoritative Patch representation of one fixture without an inline definition.

PatchInstalledFixtureAppearance.description: Portable installed lamp/filter/static-shaper appearance for one physical fixture instance.

profile_head_id.description: Stable semantic head identity from the selected immutable profile revision.

PatchProfileRevisionProjection.description: Deduplicated, Patch-only metadata for one immutable profile revision.

profile_snapshot.description:
Server-resolved parameterized profile snapshot for this revision. Patch programmer-surface
consumers build head parameters, channels, and control actions from it client-side without
the fixture catalog. Carried server->client only; the patch *request* boundary still
excludes fixture definitions. Absent (null) on older payloads, so clients must tolerate it.

referenced_modes.description: Only modes referenced by fixtures in the containing snapshot or delta, never the catalog.

PlaybackTelemetrySample.description:
One sampled volatile runtime row for a numbered Playback. Static topology stays on the
snapshot + revisioned event path; a telemetry tick carries only playbacks whose sampled
values changed since the previous tick.

fade_progress.description: 0..=1 progress into the current Cue transition, or null while no Cuelist is active.

PlaybackTelemetryTick.description: A sampled telemetry tick taken on a render-frame divider nearest ~10 Hz.

frame.description: Completed render frame this tick was sampled on.

released.description: Playback numbers that stopped reporting since the previous tick (released/offline).

sample_rate_hz.description: The telemetry sample rate implied by the configured output rate and its divider.

samples.description: Only the playbacks whose sampled values changed since the previous tick.

ProgrammerSelectionProjection.description: Ordered desk-local selection and the operation revision which produced it.

ProgrammingCaptureModeProjection.description: Authoritative capture routing for one user's Programmer.

ProgrammingInteractionChange.description: Sparse authoritative components changed by one semantic Programmer interaction.

preload_active.description: Aggregate activity signal only; active Preload values and identities remain private.

local_time.description: Civil timestamp formatted in the authoritative server timezone.

scheduled_for.description: RFC 3339 instant used for ordering and exactly-once claims.
